title: The relative_to dsM 'placement defect' is the unrecorded warm-up, not a materializer bug
verdict: NOT AN ENGINE DEFECT. Both prior measurements were correct; they measured different instants.
mechanism: trace t=0 is the state AFTER warmupSeconds of simulation. During warm-up the ego closes on the challenger at the relative closing speed, so the realised forward gap at trace t=0 is: dsM_instance - warmupSeconds*(v_ego - v_challenger*cos(dHeading)).
agreement: predicted vs actual loss agrees to <=0.02 m on 3/3 cells

reconciles.sub-agent measured instance, found place: correct - placement IS exact at instance level
reconciles.'capped near 13.6 m': artifact: loss scales with v_ego, so high-speed corridors lose more; not a cap
reconciles.correlation 0.16: loss depends on (v_ego - v_chal), which is uncorrelated with requested dsM
reconciles.C2 failures start median 8.1 m vs passin: smaller realised gap => closest approach at/near spawn => C2 fail

fix: AUTHORING-SIDE AND GENERAL, no packages/ change: compensate the requested gap by warmupSeconds*(v_ego - v_challenger), or author with warmupSeconds 0. The coverTarget() patch was correctly reverted; it addressed a cause that does not exist.
implication: A large share of the 29.3% C2 loss is this one arithmetic error. It is invisible to a blind agent and visible instantly in a t=0 render.
